feature: The stand-ins sheet's loader fills the sheet, and the desktop sheet stands at its cap (Hugh's bug, 2026-10-27)
note: Needs a server with SWAP_TOOLS_ENABLED=true, signed in as swaptools-v2+clerk_test@example.com (on local-dev today that address is user_3HdjdocERCjunk0zJQFDWyHkTd4), with SHEET_DECK its HD - Gishath (441286bb-f632-4d1e-af0f-aa7282bbb40f: an $8 limit, Polyraptor over it on Shopping). The loading row puts the page on Slow 4G before the press and holds the page's own requests (the read is a server action POST to the deck path) for 8s, so the loader is photographed rather than raced; the loaded row takes both away. Only the stand-ins sheet (and the Fits picker over a card) has a loading state: the cart's By friend view, a friend's Spares tab and a ?spare= landing open the spares-only sheet, which draws at once. This inventory writes nothing.
